messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a front-view dolly-out shot that moves from upper-body to full-body framing. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a front-view dolly-out shot that moves from upper-body to full-body framing. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in the center of the street, initially facing forward, then turns his head to look around and makes small arm gestures before returning to a neutral standing pose.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium shot that slowly zooms out to reveal the character's full body and the surrounding street.","clothing":"A white tank top with a pink and yellow palm tree graphic reading 'LOS ANGELES', pink pants, and brown sandals.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short, spiky white hair.","identity":"A 3D-rendered Black male character with a slim, muscular build and a short beard.","scene":"A cobblestone street in a European-style city, featuring brick and stone buildings, black lampposts, and a large Union Jack flag hanging in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the character from the front in a street scene with a Union Jack flag, beginning in an upper-body/medium framing and gradually pulling back to reveal the full body and surrounding street. The character's white hair, white Los Angeles tank top, pink pants, and general standing/gesturing action are retained, and the action progression appears similar to the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a front-view dolly-out shot starting from upper-body framing and ending in full-body framing, using the reference for viewing direction, subject placement, and start framing, while preserving the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and action timing.
uncertain: Whether the camera movement is a true dolly-out or a zoom-out cannot be fully distinguished from the frames.
unexpected_changes: The scene background changed from the source's soap/cocoa powder storefront to a different European-style street with a Union Jack flag, although the reference image specified this new front-view scene.
